decision.explanation: The documents provide conflicting information about which award Erik Furuhjelm received. Document d1 states he received the Pro Finlandia Medal, citing multiple sources including the Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture and the Finnish National Archives. Document d2 describes him receiving the Lakatos Award at an event in 1955. Since these accounts cannot be reconciled and neither can be definitively dismissed, both are included as independently justified claims.
